data.narrative:
Reflex Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $7M to date. The target operates within a sector populated by one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable methodology due to data constraints. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $7M total raised proxy, reflecting typical Seed-to-next-stage advancement dynamics, yielding an implied valuation of $18M. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable: while ten same-sector robotics peers exist in the dataset, the company lacked a sufficiently dense peer set when filtered by stage, adjacency, or valuation tier (minimum three datapoints required). Applying an all-sector median would introduce uncontrolled cross-sector bias and was therefore excluded.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $15M (low) to $20M (high), centered at $18M. This range reflects approximately 2.1x to 2.9x the capital deployed, consistent with early-stage venture step-ups. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-set peer comparables to validate stage-progression assumptions and limited visibility into Reflex's operational metrics relative to named peers. The single-method result constrains confidence; a subsequent financing round or expanded peer dataset would strengthen triangulation.
